A, saying you wanted to leave, wanting space, and then being unable to get out for five minutes sounds frightening, and it makes sense that you felt afraid. You do not have to minimize that. If you feel unsafe, reach out to someone you trust or a local support line, and contact emergency services if you are in immediate danger.

A pause does not erase what still needs to be said. You can ask to continue later, agree on a time, or write down what you need to say. Next time, step aside when A asks to leave, and return to the talk only when both of you can stay by choice.
